title: Wiring.
officialText:
Combustible electrical or electronic wiring methods and materials, optical fiber cable, and optical fiber
raceway exposed within a plenum shall have a peak optical density not greater than 0.50, an average optical density not greater
than 0.15, and a flame spread not greater than 5 feet (1524 mm) when tested in accordance with NFPA 262. Only type OFNP
(plenum rated nonconductive optical fiber cable) shall be installed in plenum-rated optical fiber raceways. Wiring, cable, and
raceways addressed in this section shall be listed and labeled as plenum rated and shall be installed in accordance with New
York City Electrical Code.
